These firearms hide ingenious features you'd never expect — a built-in bottle opener on the Galil, a bayonet hidden inside the MAS-36's barrel, a magazine loader tucked into the M3 Grease Gun's stock, and a cleaning kit hidden inside the AK-74. Discover the cleverest hidden firearm features in military history at Simple History.
